title: Locality of rough path lifts
summary: Every Hölder continuous path $X$ admits a geometric rough path lift $\boldsymbol{X}$ by the Lyons--Victoir extension theorem. A natural question that emerges when lifting more than one path segment at once is that of \emph{locality}, namely whether the lift $\boldsymbol{X}_{s,t}$ only depends on the increments $X_{s,u}$, $u \in [s,t]$. We investigate the locality of rough path lifts in deterministic and stochastic settings.
